chips: No chips were played so risk tolerance is the isolated variable. The normal 2x captain remained active.

manager_policies.balanced: Projected points plus 8 points of utility per forecast $1M appreciation.
manager_policies.budget_builder: Projected points plus 20 points of utility per forecast $1M appreciation.

risk_policies.total_avoidance: Lexicographically minimises negative P5 exposure before applying the manager philosophy.
risk_policies.minimal_risk_accepted: Subtracts 2.00 utility points per point of negative P5 exposure.
risk_policies.medium_tolerance: Subtracts 0.75 utility points per point of negative P5 exposure.
risk_policies.maximum_tolerance: No downside penalty; selects solely on manager philosophy.

risk_measure: Sum of max(-P5, 0) across the five drivers and two constructors in each archived pre-deadline Monte Carlo forecast.

risk_signal_diagnostics.warning: Descriptive only: the 12 paths share rounds and many assets, so they are not independent observations.
